# Altron — a voice AI companion

**Altron is a second player in your world that you talk to by voice.** Say "Altron, follow me" in voice chat and he
follows. Ask him to mine iron, craft a pickaxe, guard you, load all the steel into the press, or just ask how he is doing
— he answers out loud, in your language.

Everything runs **offline on your own PC**: a local AI model (llama.cpp), Whisper for speech recognition and Piper for
his voice. No cloud, no subscription, no API keys.

> **Note: this jar is only Altron's body.** It needs Altron's brain (a Python program) running on your PC.
> The easiest way: download **[install_altron.bat](https://github.com/zee110413-ui/altron/raw/main/install_altron.bat)**
> and double-click it — it installs the brain, the AI model, voices, Simple Voice Chat and this mod by itself.

## What he can do

- **Talk.** Answers in the language you speak, jokes, remembers what you told him, starts small talk after a quiet
  while, nods, waves and dances.
- **Work with any mod.** Reads the items, recipes and manuals of every mod in your pack, clicks through any mod's GUI,
  makes things in the machines he has seen, loads a machine with all the material in one trip, looks things up on the
  web when the pack's data is not enough.
- **Play.** Follows and guards you, fights with bows, swords and mod guns, mines like a player (no x-ray), smelts,
  crafts, builds multiblocks, drives vehicles, sleeps in a bed at night, picks his things up after he dies.
- **Remember.** Places, chests and what is in them, what each machine makes, what you said — across restarts.

## Requirements

- A **Forge 1.20.1** modpack with **Simple Voice Chat** (the installer adds it).
- Windows 10/11. An NVIDIA GPU with 8+ GB is recommended: the game, Altron's own game client and the AI run at once.
  A second PC can run the AI and Altron's client if yours is not enough.

## How to use

1. Run `install_altron.bat` once.
2. Start Altron (the desktop shortcut), wait for "ИИ готов" (AI ready).
3. Open your world and type `/altron` in chat. Altron joins in 1-2 minutes.
4. Talk in voice chat: "Altron, follow me".

Source code, settings and help: **[github.com/zee110413-ui/altron](https://github.com/zee110413-ui/altron)**
